item.text:
<linkedin_post>Google says Gemini 4 Carbon can persist for days on complex engineering tasks, including tracing subtle bugs across large codebases and low-level systems. That kind of work requires a model to stay within its assigned scope as well as produce useful code.

In internal testing, Google reports that Carbon reduced overreach by 26% and under-service by 29% compared with Gemini 4 Argon. It also reports fewer unsupported claims and an almost 80% drop in high-severity misalignment alerts in live coding environments with its teams.

Those results come from Google’s own testing. Carbon is initially available to a subset of cyber defenders, with access for developers, businesses and consumers still to come.</linkedin_post>
